claims.statement: A deposit of $599 a side (printed as $599) for the Mike McCoole and Tom Allen match was to be made at Allen's saloon on the night of 9 October 1869.
claims.excerpt: will be made at Tom Allen’s saloon,
places: Tom Allen's saloon, 1205 Fifth Street, St. Louis

claims.statement: Tom Allen's saloon was at 1205 Fifth Street, St. Louis, in October 1869.
Tom Allen and Jim Coyne were to be present at the deposit.
claims.excerpt: and Jim: Coyne will be present.
places: Tom Allen's saloon, 1205 Fifth Street, St. Louis

claims.statement: Tom Allen is matched to fight Mike McCoole, with the stakes being deposited at this time.

notes: Hint said $500; the text prints $599. The Globe-Democrat of 10 Oct gives $500 a side (article 370).
